features.text: Complete spine support system that helps reduce pain and promote proper alignment from your upper back through your lower spine, perfect for daily activities and recovery
Comfortable, breathable materials with adjustable compression straps that let you customize the support level as your needs change throughout the day
Thoughtfully designed panels work together to maintain stability while allowing necessary movement, helping you stay active during recovery
Universal design that works with your body's natural contours to provide reliable support for various back conditions and post-surgery care
